description.narrative: Allgemeine Baugesellschaft-A. Porr A.G. (Porr or the company) will undertake a series of small-to-mid size property development and waste management construction projects between 2008 and 2010 in central and southeastern Europe (CSE). These projects would each have a total project size of less than 30 million (sub-project) and would be located in Bosnia & Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, Romania, and Ukraine (the Target Markets).

By constructing and financing these varied sub-projects, which range from commercial and residential real estate development and waste water treatment and solid waste management, the following benefits will accrue: - Support to urban infrastructure: The project will support the development of commercial real estate which will provide invaluable infrastructure enabling local and foreign firms to expand their businesses. This will contribute to enhancing their competitiveness as domestic and regional centers, where the sustainable development of multi-purpose real estate plays an essential role in taking advantage of the region''s proximity to Western Europe and its location on several pan-European transport routes. - Support to public infrastructure: The project will also enhance the private sector participation in public infrastructure development under PPP and BOT structures, which still are not common in the transition economies. - Improved quality and standards: Given the companys extensive experience in construction in Western Europe, the project is expected to facilitate the transfer of technology, knowledge and know-how, thereby improving the quality and standards of planned infrastructure projects in the target countries. The company will employ EU standards in all its construction. It will also be expected to have a demonstration effect for other construction companies. Benefits to the local economies: The project will benefit the local economies as result of increased demand for construction materials, labor and other relevant inputs needed for undertaking the investments. It will also generate significant revenue for the government from wide range of taxes.
